pairs: Tunc accesserunt ad eum ab Jerosolymis scribæ et pharisæi,
Then the scribes and the Pharisees came to him from Jerusalem,
Quare discipuli tui transgrediuntur traditionem seniorum?
“Why do your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders?
non enim lavant manus suas cum panem manducant.
For they do not wash their hands when they eat bread.”
et vos transgredimini mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram?
“And why do you transgress the commandment of God for the sake of your tradition?
Qui maledixerit patri, vel matri, morte moriatur.
‘Whoever will have cursed father or mother shall die a death.’
Vos autem dicitis: Quicumque dixerit patri,
But you say: ‘If anyone will have said to father or mother,
quodcumque est ex me, tibi proderit:
so that whatever is from me will benefit you,”
then he shall not honor his father or his mother.’
So have you nullified the commandment of God,
et irritum fecistis mandatum Dei propter traditionem vestram.
for the sake of your tradition.
How well did Isaiah prophesy about you,
‘This people honors me with their lips,
cor autem eorum longe est a me.
but their heart is far from me.
For in vain do they worship me,
teaching the doctrines and commandments of men.’”
And having called the multitudes to him,
Non quod intrat in os, coinquinat hominem:
A man is not defiled by what enters into the mouth,
but by what proceeds from the mouth.
This is what defiles a man.”
Then his disciples drew near and said to him,
Scis quia pharisæi audito verbo hoc,
Omnis plantatio, quam non plantavit Pater meus cælestis, eradicabitur.
“Every plant which has not been planted by my heavenly Father shall be uprooted.
cæcus autem si cæco ducatum præstet,
But if the blind are in charge of the blind,
both will fall into the pit.”
And responding, Peter said to him,
Adhuc et vos sine intellectu estis?
Non intelligitis quia omne quod in os intrat, in ventrem vadit,
Do you not understand that everything that enters into the mouth goes into the gut,
and is cast into the sewer?
But what proceeds from the mouth,
and those are the things that defile a man.
de corde enim exeunt cogitationes malæ,
For from the heart go out evil thoughts,
These are the things that defile a man.
Non lotis autem manibus manducare, non coinquinat hominem.
But to eat without washing hands does not defile a man.”
Et egressus inde Jesus secessit in partes Tyri
Jesus withdrew into the areas of Tyre and Sidon.
Et ecce mulier chananæa a finibus illis egressa clamavit,
And behold, a woman of Canaan, going out from those parts,
filia mea male a dæmonio vexatur.
Son of David. My daughter is badly afflicted by a demon.”
He did not say a word to her.
Et accedentes discipuli ejus rogabant eum dicentes:
And his disciples, drawing near, petitioned him,
for she is crying out after us.”
Non sum missus nisi ad oves,
“I was not sent except to the sheep who have fallen away from the house of Israel.”
Non est bonum sumere panem filiorum,
“It is not good to take the bread of the children and cast it to the dogs.”
et catelli edunt de micis quæ cadunt de mensa dominorum suorum.
but the young dogs also eat from the crumbs that fall from the table of their masters.”
magna est fides tua: fiat tibi sicut vis.
great is your faith. Let it be done for you just as you wish.”
Et sanata est filia ejus ex illa hora.
And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
And when Jesus had passed from there,
he arrived beside the sea of Galilee.
Et accesserunt ad eum turbæ multæ,
And great multitudes came to him,
et projecerunt eos ad pedes ejus,
And they cast them down at his feet,
so much so that the crowds wondered,
And they magnified the God of Israel.
because they have persevered with me now for three days,
and they do not have anything to eat.
And I am not willing to dismiss them, fasting,
lest they faint along the way.”
Et dicunt ei discipuli: Unde ergo nobis in deserto panes tantos, ut saturemus turbam tantam?
And the disciples said to him: “From where, then, in the desert, would we obtain enough bread to satisfy so a great multitude?”
“How many loaves of bread do you have?”
Et præcepit turbæ ut discumberent super terram.
And he instructed the crowds to recline upon the ground.
and the disciples gave to the people.
And they all ate and were satisfied.
from what was left over of the fragments,
they took up seven full baskets.
Erant autem qui manducaverunt quatuor millia hominum,
But those who ate were four thousand men,
ascendit in naviculam: et venit in fines Magedan.
he climbed into a boat. And he went into the coastal region of Magadan.
